question: From which five-year plan did India start its journey of industrialisation?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Second Five-year Plan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India embarked on its journey of **industrialization during the Second Five-Year Plan (1956–1961) **
 
• This plan aimed to put **India on the path of industrial growth and development.**
 
• It **focused primarily on heavy industries,** including iron and steel, heavy engineering, and fertilizer industries.
 
• The three new iron and steel plants were established in **Bhilai, Durgapur, and Rourkela** during this period.
